missing: An hour-by-hour load table for these exact appliances (small fridge, LED lights, phones, fan), leading to one recommended power station plus panel kit with current prices. Ideally it also shows measured runtime for a small fridge and covers whether to leave the fridge off between visits.
why: None of the results is a major reviewer or an authority. They are niche sites that work from published specs or calculators, affiliate roundups and an installer lead-generation page. Only three give a direct size for this weekend load: Watt & Warden, Spark Powered and The Brick Fantastic. Their answers disagree (200 to 400W of panel, 1 to 2kWh of battery) and none shows testing you could check. Several others size for a full-size fridge at 2.8 to 4 kWh a day or a DIY wired system, which is more than this shopper needs. A focused page with a clear pick and current prices would stand out.
